posts.name: Lazareth
posts.cooked:
Unfortunately they've been sold out and hard to find for non KS backers for a little while now. The main redeeming factor here is like you say, they chose not to make them exclusive to KS (BRAVO) and have been (and soon to be again) made available for purchase to the general public, albeit in very limited quantities…which was what I meant to convey… My use of the term "exclusive" was poor wording on my part in this case. I rarely proofread my quick comments.

I don't mind that "early bird" approach to KS bonuses and approve ( I wish more KS project creators used it) just as long as said extras are made adequately available and in sufficient quantities at some point afterwards for those of us who missed the KS or just don't prefer using that method for acquiring new games in the first place.

I'm curious to know just how many sets of promos were ordered for the restock.
